title: Get Your Groove on with jingram’s Latest Single, “Chemistry.”
htmlContent:
If you’re looking for a song to add to your late-night playlist, jingram’s “Chemistry” is a must-listen. The indie house track features a smooth, groovy beat perfect for those sultry, intimate moments.

With his latest release, jingram showcases his versatility as an artist, effortlessly blending different genres to create a unique sound that’s all his own. The sensual lyrics and catchy melody make “Chemistry” a track you won’t get out of your head.

jingram, whose real name is Jack Ingram, is a multi-talented artist who wears many hats in the music industry. His music is deeply personal and often inspired by his relationships with the people in his life.

Overall, “Chemistry” is a standout track that’s sure to get you in the mood. If you’re a fan of the indie house or just looking for something new and exciting to listen to, give jingram’s latest single a spin.
